div.div:
Private DNS zones are global. Link each zone to BOTH hub VNets — only the inbound endpoint that receives the query has to be healthy.
The per-region lab. zone copies let every probe record which region answered.

div.div:
Normal operation
Each client queries its preferred inbound endpoint (spoke B → IE1). The other endpoint is a hot standby that serves the same zones.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 120, 212), rgb(63, 166, 245)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

div.div:
Failover
IE1 or region r1 becomes unreachable. The client's own resolver times out and retries the next listed server (IE2). Measured: Linux ≈5 s, Windows 17–56 s, BIND ≈ one query timeout.

div.div:
Failback
When IE1 recovers, Linux returns to IE1 on the next query; Windows and BIND return after their server-health timers expire. No DNS or VNet configuration changes are needed.
